caption: A football kicked at goal hits the crossbar and drops down onto the goal line.

sa.check: A football is kicked at a goal.
It drops down onto the goal line.
The hit comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: It rebounds off the bar at the moment of contact.
pc.fail: It changes course before the bar; or passes through; or leaves faster than it arrived.

pc.expect: It falls under gravity to the line.
pc.fail: It hangs; or rises; or floats.

pc.expect: The bar stays rigid and the ball squashes briefly.
pc.fail: The bar bends; or the ball stays flat; or the ball sticks.

pc.expect: The ball does not pass through the bar or the net.
pc.fail: It passes through the bar; or through the net; or the net passes through the ball.

pc.expect: One ball and one goal keep their number.
pc.fail: The ball duplicates; or vanishes; or the goal changes shape.

pc.expect: The ball and the goal stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the goal changes; or the pitch rearranges.
